text:
Tara: Prototype: per-chain routing 'what-if' slider in Cost dashboard. Simulates moving X% traffic to cheaper variants and shows token-cost, cache hit delta, and per-model unit econ. Screenshot: https://tinyurl.com/rw-route-sim
Josh: Love it. Is this client-side only or are we calling a simulation endpoint?
Tara: Backend sim. We precompute model perf/cost profiles per SKU, then run weighted sim over traffic samples (30d). It outputs token_cost_est, cache_delta_est, latency_p50_change.
Li: We need to be careful with sample bias. Current traffic skew for canaries will underrepresent cold prompts. Proposal: run stratified sampling by promptshape buckets.
Anika: UX: slider label should be 'Shift traffic to cheaper variant' with tooltip 'est token cost, est latency impact, est cache savings'. Also add a 'confidence' band.
Priya: Important for sales: add 'monthly $ estimate' and export CSV.
CostBot: Simulation run summary: base_cost=$12,340 → simulated_cost=$10,850 (-12.0%), est_cache_savings=+1.8% (prefetch hit down 0.9%), latency_p50=+12ms. Note: based on 30d sampled traffic.
Josh: ```
POST /v1/econ/simulate
{ "route": "search", "shift_to": "gpt-lite-quant", "pct": 0.3 }
```
Li: We should append telemetry events: econ.simulate.run, econ.simulate.param_shift, econ.simulate.result_percent_change. Also tag with sample_version.
Tara: Action items: 1) Eng: add endpoint + 30d batch job (Josh). 2) Data: stratified sample config (Li). 3) Design: tooltip + CSV export (Anika). 4) PM: PRD + sales note (Priya).
Josh: Will spin up a small sketch this week. One question: do we credit cache savings to origin route or split pro-rata? I prefer pro-rata to avoid double-counting.
Li: Pro-rata makes downstream billing simpler; but for per-tenant previews we should show both split rules. Add a toggle.
Anika: :thumbsup: I'll mock with both toggles: 'Assign cache savings' -> [Pro-rata | Origin-first].
Priya: Also add guardrail messaging: 'Sim results are estimates based on sampled traffic — not a billing guarantee.'
Deploy-bot: created simulation job job/route-sim-1788123456 at 2025-11-02T14:32Z.
Tara: Thanks. Let's sync tomorrow 11am to review mocks. /remind @channel tomorrow 11am review sim prototype :calendar:
